SELECT SUM(ch.population) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(population) FROM main."country_history" WHERE effective_month = '2026-03') AS asian_ratioFROM main."country" cJOIN main."country_history" ch ON c."Code" = ch.codeWHERE ch.effective_month = '2026-03' AND c."Continent" = 'Asia'
